reason: Two impact-4 items in window: (1) US air strikes on Iran / ceasefire 'effectively over' drove KSE-100 down 4,626.18 points (-2.48%) Wednesday with Rs474bn market-cap loss and heavyweight E&P/bank selling (Dawn, 2026-07-09); market has since partially recovered (+982.10 Friday to 182,241.78) but geopolitical and oil-price risk remains live. (2) Government hiked petrol +Rs13.18 to Rs310.71/litre and HSD +Rs13.80 to Rs323.30/litre effective 2026-07-11 (Mettis Global) - inflationary shock with direct OMC/refinery read-through ahead of the next SBP MPC.
